author: Mowengeist
quote: I played this game for a couple of hours with my cousin and it's really disappointing. We saw MANY bugs in the game, and the first chapter is really boring, slow. I haven't wanted to continue playing it because I'm waiting for them to fix the game's bugs, i'm not playing ts.

author: Mowengeist
quote: Es un juego increible, superó por completo todas mis espectativas. El rediseño de personajes y escenarios es único, los graficos hermosos, y la historia capta la misma emocion que la del juego de 1998.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
